edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender identity used throughout the token logic
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole supply to _msgSender() without any access restriction
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial balance
Constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor with the fee receiver
ServicePayer constructor makes an external payable call into an arbitrary receiver contract
msg.value is forwarded to the untrusted external receiver through the pay call
_mint creates new tokens directed at the caller derived address
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount
_mint adds the amount to the recipient balance entry
_transfer subtracts the amount from the sender balance
_transfer adds the amount to the recipient balance
_burn subtracts the burned amount from the account balance
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer
transferFrom updates the remaining allowance via _approve
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve
ERC20 constructor stores the name_ parameter into _name
ERC20 constructor stores the symbol_ parameter into _symbol
_mint writes the updated value of the _totalSupply state variable
_mint writes the recipient entry of the _balances mapping
_transfer writes both sender and recipient entries of _balances
_approve writes the owner to spender entry of _allowances
initialBalance_ parameter is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor
initialBalance_ flows into the _mint arithmetic updating supply and balance
feeReceiver_ parameter is passed to the ServicePayer constructor
receiver parameter is cast to IPayable and called externally
serviceName parameter is forwarded inside the external pay call
currentAllowance local drives the allowance subtraction in transferFrom
senderBalance local drives the balance subtraction in _transfer
accountBalance local drives the balance subtraction in _burn
recipient parameter determines the destination balance entry in _transfer
amount parameter is the operand of the balance arithmetic in _transfer
spender parameter indexes the _allowances entry written by _approve

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only a constructor parameter feeding the ERC20 constructor call
symbol_ is only a constructor parameter feeding the ERC20 constructor call
initialBalance_ is only used as the amount argument of the _mint operation
feeReceiver_ is only used as the receiver argument of the ServicePayer constructor
receiver is only used inside the ServicePayer constructor external pay call
serviceName is only used inside the ServicePayer constructor external pay call
recipient is only used to select the destination balance in _transfer
amount is only used as the arithmetic operand in _transfer
spender is only used to index the allowance entry in _approve
currentAllowance is a temporary computed inside transferFrom before _approve
senderBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer before the balance update
accountBalance is a temporary computed inside _burn before the balance update
